item.description:
New

  • Send HTTP/1.1, HTTP/2, GraphQL, WebSocket, Server-Sent Events and gRPC requests, and see exactly what went over the wire: raw bytes, every redirect hop and a full timing breakdown.
  • Workspaces are folders of readable TOML files you can keep in Git; secrets stay in the Keychain.
  • Import from Postman, Insomnia, Bruno, Paw, OpenAPI, HAR and cURL, check responses with tests, and run whole folders in the Runner or with the echolot command-line tool.
  • Design OpenAPI specs, serve them as local mocks, and chain requests into flows on a canvas.
  • Inspect and call MCP servers, and let AI agents work in your workspace through Echolot's own MCP server.
  • The Assistant, built in: it sends, tests and fixes requests with your own model keys, and asks before it changes anything.
  • Echolot updates itself (Echolot › Check for Updates…), and Help › What's New in Echolot shows what changed.
